newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes up in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed up by 0.36 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 516.67 from 514.83 on Tuesday.
Total volume was 1.79 million dinars against 646,670 dinars over the previous session.
Banque de Tunisie rose 2.3 dinars to 79.8 dinars. BNA bank gained 0.9 dinar to 30.9. Banque du Sud was up 0.78 dinar to 26.9.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing rose 0.5 dinar to 34 dinars. Airliner Tunis Air advanced 0.36 dinar to 23.3. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was up 0.25 dinar to 13.75 dinars.
BIAT bank was down 0.5 dinar to 37.5 dinars. UIB bank declined 0.43 dinar to 14.02.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF fell 0.18 dinar to 20.7 dinars.
